g.text: The scheduled-flight on-time rate stays exactly unchanged in every conversion case
Original N and on-time count O are held fixed; floor(q × D) delayed counts move to cancelled counts.
This is a mechanical denominator test, not evidence of actual airline actions or passenger benefit.
